ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT made as of the _I9h day of December, 2014, by and between 298 Mulberry Street Operating Development, 80 Broad Street, New York, New York 10004 ("Qwner"), and 304 Mulberry Street Operating Company, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Broad Street Development, 80 Broad Street, New York, New York 10004 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are each a “Party” and sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of New York, known as Lot 1 in Block 521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 298 - 302 Mulberry Street, New York, New York 10012, as more particularly described on Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements now or in the future located on Owner Land are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of NewYork, known as Lot 9 in Block 521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 304 - 308 Mulberry Street, New York, New York 10012, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B-1" annexed hereto and made a part hereof and the land known as Lot 3 in Block 521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B-2" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (collectively referred to herein as "Developer Land”' and, together with the buildings and improvements presently located on Developer Land, referred to herein as “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, Developer may demolish the Existing Developer Building and construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land, and construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land, and the Existing Developer Building or the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the "DeveloperParcel"); 1
